title: PhishGuard Enterprise Browser Security Policy
description: Chrome Managed Storage policy for corporate Google Workspace / Active Directory deployment.

PhishGuardApiBaseUrl.title: PhishGuard Backend URL
PhishGuardApiBaseUrl.description: The base URL of the company's centralized PhishGuard security platform (e.g. https://security.company.com).

EnrollmentToken.title: Organization Enrollment Token
EnrollmentToken.description: The secret enrollment token generated by the PhishGuard administrator for fleet device registration.

EnforcementMode.title: Enforcement Mode
EnforcementMode.description: Policy enforcement behavior: BLOCK (instantly block navigation), WARN (show interactive warning), or MONITOR (silent logging).

TelemetryEnabled.title: Security Telemetry Enabled
TelemetryEnabled.description: Whether anonymized privacy-guaranteed security events are synchronized to the central dashboard.
